description: Read-only. Returns the current status of a request created with request_quotes, plus any assigned contractor and quotes on file. Requires the request_id and either the email or the phone number given on the request. It never returns the customer's contact details, address, or internal notes.
name: get_request_status

quotes.description: Every quote on file. No cap. Empty until a contractor or operator records one.

title: Check a request's status
